heading: side
name: 固定側欄標題組＋直向卡片列
desc: 左欄是一張接一張往下排的卡片，右欄是標題組；捲動時標題組固定在畫面上，卡片正常捲過，標題組下緣和最後一張卡片下緣齊平時解除固定。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊，捲動時其中一欄固定在畫面上，另一欄正常捲動經過：右側的標題組固定，左側的卡片欄正常捲動。左右兩欄：左欄約佔內容寬度六成，放多個項目由上往下排成一直列，每列一張卡片；右欄約佔四成，放標題組，靠左對齊。標題組包含大標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略；大標題明顯大於卡片裡的標題。每個項目是一張有外框的獨立卡片容器，圖片、標題、說明文字和按鈕全部放在卡片內，都不貼齊卡片邊緣：橫式圖片在上，下方是標題，再下方左側是說明文字、右側是一顆圓形圖示按鈕，按鈕與說明文字垂直置中；所有卡片的圖片同一比例。標題欄和卡片欄一樣高，標題組只有自身高度，在欄內固定在畫面上方附近；卡片欄的內容較長，正常捲動，固定期間約捲動三個畫面高度。標題組一直固定到它的下緣和最後一張卡片的下緣齊平時就解除固定，此時最後一張卡片仍在畫面中、卡片欄還沒捲完，之後兩欄一起隨頁面往上捲走。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，取消固定：標題組移到區塊最上方靠左，按鈕改為置中放在說明文字下方；卡片在下方，每列一張，橫跨內容寬度。卡片內圖片在上，標題與圓形圖示按鈕放在同一列（按鈕在右），說明文字移到這一列下方。區塊最下方可再放一顆置中的按鈕，沒有時省略。

en.name: Pinned side heading group + vertical card list
en.desc: The left column is a stack of cards running down the page and the right column holds the heading group; on scroll the heading group stays fixed while the cards scroll past, and it unpins once its bottom edge lines up with the bottom edge of the last card.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content, in which one column stays fixed in view while the other scrolls past: the heading group on the right stays fixed, and the card column on the left scrolls normally. Two columns: the left column takes about sixty percent of the content width and holds multiple items arranged top to bottom as a list of rows, one card per row; the right column takes about forty percent and holds the heading group, aligned left. The heading group contains a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content; the headline is clearly larger than the titles inside the cards. Each item is a separate card container with its own outline; the image, title, description and button all sit inside the card, and none of them is flush with the edge of its container: a landscape image on top, a title below it, and below that a description on the left and a circular icon button on the right, with the button vertically centered against the description; all card images share the same proportions. The heading column is as tall as the card column, while the heading group is only as tall as its own content and stays fixed near the top of the viewport within its column; the card column is longer and scrolls normally, and the pinned phase lasts about three viewport heights of scrolling. The heading group stays fixed only until its bottom edge lines up with the bottom edge of the last card, and then unpins while the last card is still in view and before the card column has finished scrolling; after that both columns scroll up with the page together.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically and remove the pinning: the heading group moves to the top of the section, aligned left, with its button centered below the description; the cards follow below, one per row, spanning the content width. Inside each card the image stays on top, the title and the circular icon button sit on the same row (button on the right), and the description moves below that row. Optionally place one more centered button at the very bottom of the section; omit it when there is no content.

extras.name: 滑過卡片時傾斜並露出後方底板
extras.prompt: 區塊裡的每張卡片在滑鼠滑過時微微傾斜，卡片後方露出一塊同樣大小、不傾斜的底板；卡片裡的圓形圖示按鈕上方同時出現一行沿著按鈕弧線排列的小字。滑鼠離開後卡片轉回原位，底板與小字消失。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消這個效果，卡片維持不傾斜。

en.name: Card hover: tilt with a backing panel revealed
en.prompt: When the mouse hovers over a card in the section, the card tilts slightly and a backing panel of the same size, not tilted, is revealed behind it; at the same time a short line of small text appears above the card's circular icon button, following the curve of the button. When the mouse leaves, the card turns back into place and the backing panel and the small text disappear.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: On touch devices the effect is removed and the cards stay untilted.
